title: Integrating machine learning and pharmacology reveals NF-kappaB-mediated inflammatory regulation by Shuanghuanglian injection in acute lung injury.
authors: Liu, Can; Qiao, Ru; Tian, Qiang; He, Fuyuan
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习与分子对接研究中药注射剂对急性肺损伤的NF-κB炎症调控，虽涉及NF-κB转录因子但无蛋白-DNA互作建模，核心为药理网络与湿实验验证，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Shuanghuanglian Injection (SHLI) is a traditional Chinese medicine formulation derived from Lonicerae Japonicae Flos, Scutellariae Radix, and Forsythiae Fructus and developed based on the TCM principle of heat-clearing and detoxifying. It has been widely used for respiratory infections and inflammatory disorders, but its protective mechanisms in acute lung injury (ALI) warrant further investigation. AIM OF THE STUDY: To characterize the chemical profile of SHLI and delineate its pharmacological mechanisms in ALI, with particular attention to inflammatory regulation and the NF-kappaB signaling cascade. MATERIALS AND METHODS: UPLC-MS/MS profiling defined the chemical components of SHLI. Candidate targets were retrieved from TCMSP, GeneCards, DisGeNET, and the Open Targets Platform, then organized into a protein-protein interaction network with subsequent enrichment analyses. Transcriptomic data from GEO provided differentially expressed genes, which were further refined using a combination of machine learning approaches (LASSO, random forest, SVM-RFE, and XGBoost) to prioritize key targets. Molecular docking assessed the binding affinity between representative compounds and targets. An LPS-induced ALI rat model was used to verify therapeutic effects through hematological indices, histopathology, RT-qPCR, ELISA, and Western blot assays. RESULTS: 10 principal components were identified and quantified in SHLI, predominantly flavonoids and phenolic acids. Integrating network pharmacology with machine learning highlighted three genes (IL-1alpha, IL-1beta and TNFAIP6) as central nodes. Docking analysis suggested that quercetin interacts stably with these key targets. In vivo, SHLI mitigated lung injury in a dose-dependent manner and partially restored disordered leukocyte responses while lowering pro-inflammatory cytokine levels. At the molecular level, SHLI modulated the transcription of IL-1alpha, IL-1beta and TNFAIP6 and reduced the secretion of TNF-alpha, IL-1beta and TNFAIP6. Concurrently, SHLI dampened NF-kappaB activation by limiting IkappaBalpha phosphorylation and restraining p65 activation. CONCLUSION: SHLI protects against ALI through coordinated multi-component, multi-target interactions, with its core mechanism associated with the suppression of NF-kappaB mediated inflammatory responses.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：双黄连注射液（SHLI）是一种基于中医清热解毒原则，由金银花、黄芩和连翘制成的中药制剂。它广泛用于呼吸道感染和炎症性疾病，但其在急性肺损伤（ALI）中的保护机制仍需进一步研究。研究目的：表征SHLI的化学成分谱，并阐明其在ALI中的药理机制，特别关注炎症调控和NF-kappaB信号级联。材料与方法：采用UPLC-MS/MS分析确定SHLI的化学成分。从TCMSP、GeneCards、DisGeNET和Open Targets Platform检索候选靶点，构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络并进行富集分析。GEO的转录组数据提供差异表达基因，结合机器学习方法（LASSO、随机森林、SVM-RFE和XGBoost）进一步筛选关键靶点。分子对接评估代表性化合物与靶点之间的结合亲和力。使用LPS诱导的ALI大鼠模型，通过血液学指标、组织病理学、RT-qPCR、ELISA和Western blot实验验证治疗效果。结果：在SHLI中鉴定并定量了10种主要成分，主要为黄酮类和酚酸类。整合网络药理学和机器学习，突出三个基因（IL-1alpha、IL-1beta和TNFAIP6）作为核心节点。对接分析表明，槲皮素与这些关键靶点稳定结合。在体内，SHLI以剂量依赖性方式减轻肺损伤，部分恢复紊乱的白细胞反应，并降低促炎细胞因子水平。在分子水平上，SHLI调节IL-1alpha、IL-1beta和TNFAIP6的转录，并减少TNF-alpha、IL-1beta和TNFAIP6的分泌。同时，SHLI通过限制IkappaBalpha磷酸化和抑制p65激活来抑制NF-kappaB活化。结论：SHLI通过协调的多组分、多靶点相互作用保护ALI，其核心机制与抑制NF-kappaB介导的炎症反应相关。
